# `⌺` — Stencil

`f⌺S Y` applies `f` to neighbourhoods of sizes `S` on leading axes. Windows receive prototype fill at edges.

Negative sizes in [Windows](windows.qmd) return the same windows as one array.

```apl
{+/,⍵}⌺3⊢1 2 3 4   ⍝ 3 6 9 7
```

`⍵` is the window; `⍺` gives signed padding counts per axis: positive at the start, negative at the end. A two-row specification gives sizes then movements.

```apl
{+/,⍵}⌺([3 ⋄ 2])⍳8  ⍝ 3 9 15 21
```

Results assemble with fill. RANK: specification not a scalar, vector or two-row matrix, or more axes than `Y`. LENGTH: a matrix without two rows. DOMAIN: no axes, nonpositive sizes or movements, or a size of at least twice its axis length.
